name: Pauli X propagates through CZ
summary: A Pauli X on one qubit of a CZ becomes an X on that qubit and a Z on the other.
description:
Pushing a Pauli X gate through a CZ gate produces an extra Pauli Z on the other qubit: $\mathrm{CZ}\,(X\otimes I) = (X\otimes Z)\,\mathrm{CZ}$. In the ZX-calculus the π X-phase is copied by the Z-spider of the CZ by [π-commutation](../pi-commutation/); the copy that travels along the Hadamard edge becomes a π Z-phase by the [colour change](../colour-change/) rule.

This is the basic rule behind the stabilisers of graph states: an X on a vertex together with Z on all its neighbours stabilises the graph state.
